segments.text: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
segments.translation: 火灾过后，村庄面临什么危险？

segments.text: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
segments.translation: 消防队员们与那场森林大火搏斗了将近3个星期才将火势控制住。

segments.text: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
segments.translation: 就在不久之前，方圆数英里的土地上还覆盖着大树。

segments.text: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
segments.translation: 现在，在那满目荒凉的山丘上，在那温热的地面上仍然升起袅袅青烟。

segments.text: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction,
segments.translation: 冬季即将来临，那些山丘对周围的村庄构成了威胁，

segments.text: for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
segments.translation: 因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会引发严重的水灾。

segments.text: When the fire had at last been put out,
the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
segments.translation: 森林当局订购了好几吨一种能够迅速生长的特殊类型的草籽。

segments.text: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
segments.translation: 飞机把这种草籽大量地撒播在地面上。

segments.text: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
segments.translation: 飞机播种了将近一个月，开始下雨了。

segments.text: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
segments.translation: 然而到那时候，许多地方的草已经生了根。

segments.text: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries,
segments.translation: 代替那些在那里生长了数百年的大树的，

segments.text: patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
segments.translation: 是一片片的绿色开始出现在被烧焦的土地上。
